chunks: No weariness will come upon them, nor will they be sent away from there.

key_terms.مِنْهَا بِمُخْرَجِينَ: sent away from it, expelled, or removed

ai.seo_question: What are the two main blessings promised to the inhabitants of Paradise regarding fatigue and permanence?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, 'nasab' (fatigue) is interpreted not merely as physical tiredness but as the spiritual weariness of worship and the burden of worldly duties, which are entirely absent in the eternal state of bliss. The promise of non-expulsion ('mukhrajīn') underscores the permanence of divine grace for the righteous, a concept often linked to the Ahl al-Bayt's eternal station in Paradise. This verse thus serves as a reassurance of both the quality of worship and the certainty of eternal abode for the faithful.
